findings.title: SSL Certificate Expiring in < 30 Days
findings.plainEnglishCause: The TLS certificate is valid but expires in less than 30 days. Auto-renewal may be misconfigured or failing.

fixSteps.instruction: Verify automated renewal cron and DNS verification hooks.

findings.title: Poor Largest Contentful Paint (LCP > 4.0s)
findings.plainEnglishCause: The largest visible element (hero image, banner, or heading) took longer than 4.0 seconds to render, signaling significant perceptual slowness.

fixSteps.instruction: Preload critical hero images and optimize image formats using modern AVIF/WebP.
Ensure server response time (TTFB) is fast and avoid render-blocking CSS/JavaScript.

findings.title: Missing Meta Description Tag
findings.plainEnglishCause: The HTML document lacks a <meta name="description"> tag. Search engines may display arbitrary page text in search result snippets.
findings.technicalDetails: Missing <meta name="description"> tag in document head.

fixSteps.instruction: Add a concise, informative meta description (50-160 characters) inside the <head> tag.
fixSteps.codeSnippet:
<head>
  <meta name="description" content="SiteDoctor — Real-Time Full-Stack Health & Fix Diagnostics Platform." />
</head>

findings.title: Image Missing Alternative Text (WCAG 1.1.1)
findings.plainEnglishCause: An element does not have an 'alt' attribute. Screen readers cannot describe the image to visually impaired users.
findings.technicalDetails: Found 1 element(s) without an alt attribute.

fixSteps.instruction: Add a descriptive 'alt' attribute to the tag, or alt="" if the image is purely decorative.

findings.title: Insufficient Color Contrast (WCAG 1.4.3 AA)
findings.plainEnglishCause: Text elements do not meet the minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio against their background color, making text hard or impossible to read for users with visual impairments.
findings.technicalDetails: Rule: color-contrast (serious). HTML: Free Software Supporter

fixSteps.instruction: Adjust the foreground text color or background color to satisfy WCAG AA contrast guidelines.

findings.title: Broken Internal Link (404 Not Found)
findings.plainEnglishCause: The internal page crawler encountered a link leading to a 404 dead page on your domain. Broken links damage user experience and SEO rankings.

fixSteps.instruction: Update or remove the dead href link, or configure a 301 redirect on your server.

findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) Header
findings.plainEnglishCause: The server does not enforce HTTPS connections via HSTS. Users communicating over insecure networks are vulnerable to SSL stripping and man-in-the-middle (MITM) attacks.
findings.technicalDetails: Strict-Transport-Security header is absent in response headers.

fixSteps.instruction: Add the Strict-Transport-Security header to your HTTPS server block in Nginx.

findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) Header
findings.plainEnglishCause: No Content-Security-Policy header was detected. Without a CSP, the application is vulnerable to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), clickjacking, and rogue script injection.

fixSteps.instruction: Add the Content-Security-Policy header directive in your Nginx server block.
fixSteps.codeSnippet:
# /etc/nginx/sites-available/your-site
add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https:; img-src 'self' data: https:; connect-src 'self' https:;" always;

findings.codeSnippet:

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options Header (Clickjacking Risk)
findings.plainEnglishCause: The page does not set X-Frame-Options, allowing third-party malicious sites to embed your pages inside an iframe and trick users into clicking hidden buttons (clickjacking).

fixSteps.instruction: Add X-Frame-Options in your Nginx configuration.

findings.title: High Latency Under Light Concurrent Load (10 Reqs)
findings.plainEnglishCause: During a light test with 10 concurrent requests, average response latency exceeded 1500ms. This indicates potential thread contention, unindexed database queries, or server resource bottlenecks.

fixSteps.instruction: Profile backend handlers, add database indexes on queried fields, and implement connection pooling.

findings.title: Server Errors Under Light Concurrent Load
findings.plainEnglishCause: The server produced 5xx errors or connection drops when handling 10 simultaneous requests. The backend is struggling with concurrency.
findings.technicalDetails: Failed requests under 10 concurrent requests. Status distribution: {"200":6,"Network_Error":4}

fixSteps.instruction: Check server logs for unhandled rejection errors, database connection pool exhaustion, or memory limits.
